description: This Java source file defines the class LayoutFilePullParser, which extends KXmlParser and implements ILayoutPullParser. It adds layout-specific parsing behavior for Android layout XML files, including handling fragment tags and converting certain attribute values. It also provides methods for creating parser instances and retrieving view cookies.
